waypoints.name: Pinnacle Saddle Trailhead (Reflection Lakes, Stevens Canyon Road)
waypoints.note: Approach to the Lane Peak north face couloirs from Stevens Canyon Road.
waypoints.directions: From the Nisqually Entrance of Mount Rainier National Park, drive about 15 miles past Longmire toward Paradise and bear right onto Stevens Canyon Road. The Reflection Lakes parking is about 1.5 miles on, with the trailhead across the road. A park entrance pass is required. Stevens Canyon Road is closed roughly November to May; then park at Narada Falls and climb about 200 ft through the timber to regain the road.

waypoints.name: Lane Peak - Zipper couloir
waypoints.note: The Zipper is the left-leaning ~45-degree couloir at the center of the north face; ice axe/crampons required.
